newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan gas oil output hits record high in August.
newsitem.headline: Japan gas oil output hits record high in August.

text.p: Japan's production of gas oil hit a record high of 4.47 million kilolitres in August, an official at the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Thursday.
The August gas oil output figures represented a 7.5 percent increase from August 1995 and a 6.9 percent rise from July, the official said.
Japan's gas oil production hit a record for the second consecutive month in August. Output in July amounted to 4.2 million kl.
The MITI official said gas oil production in August last year was low because some refineries were closed for regular maintenance checks and due to accidents.
